validation.spec_summary: The Defender Clone project delivers a browser‑based arcade shooter reminiscent of the 1981 Defender game. The stack consists of a Python 3.11+ FastAPI backend (served by Uvicorn) that delivers static assets and provides an optional in‑memory high‑score API, and a vanilla JavaScript/HTML5 Canvas frontend. All source code resides under the `defender/` directory. Backend responsibilities include routes for `/`, static file serving, and `/score` POST/GET endpoints; they must be fully covered by pytest tests located in `defender/backend/tests`. The frontend comprises a full‑screen canvas, CSS styling, and a collection of JavaScript modules (`input.js`, `player.js`, `enemies.js`, `humanoids.js`, `bullets.js`, `world.js`, `hud.js`, `renderer.js`, `main.js`). These modules implement keyboard controls (A/D/arrow, W/S, Space, Enter, P, Escape), entity movement, collision, scoring logic, and a neon‑styled rendering pipeline at 60 fps. A comprehensive README explains how to install backend dependencies (`pip install -r backend/requirements.txt`), start the server (`uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload`), and play the game in a browser. Automated QA runs the full pytest suite from `defender/backend`. Frontend Vitest tests are optional stretch goals. Successful delivery results in a playable game with functional movement, firing, enemy spawning, scoring, HUD, and high‑score persistence, and all backend tests passing.
